notes.title: Leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello combat pilots![/h1]

[b]Road Rage Royale V1.0[/b] is live and leaving Early Access !
It has been quite a ride for more than 3 years.
Road Rage Royale's development is now stopping until further notice

I wish you all the best,
Barmy Failure (aka The Neural Oscillations Games Team)

[h1]--- PATCH NOTES ---[/h1]
v0.326 :

- Added Announcer Sounds.
- Fixed a bug with AIPilot car colors.
- Tweaked Music and Sounds default mix.
- Fixed a music bug when pausing the game when a round is over.
- Fixed a click Throught bug in player selection menu
- Tweaked Round End Animations.
- Reworked Game Over Screen.
- Updated Logo.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello combat pilots![/h1]

[b]Update 2[/b] is live and here is the [b]Living Roadmap[/b] to the future :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564953/38e54557aed276942ab566db7b4f58a9ab27ad2e.png[/img]

I wish you all the best,
Barmy Failure (aka The Neural Oscillations Games Team)

[h1]--- PATCH NOTES ---[/h1]
v0.320-> v0.325 :

- v0.321 :
     - Updated to Unity 2019.4.8f1
     - Integrated new Car Parts.
     - Tweaked Car Parts Shaders.
     - Randomized AI Pilot Parts.
     - Randomized AI Pilot Car Colors.
     - Car Color and Paint Color are now customizable.
     - Car Parts can now be changed.
     - Only one player can pick a color at any given time.
     - B button can be used to cancel or go back in menus.
     - Player name now take the main color of his car.
     - Text colors changed in player selection menu.
     - Prevented cars from falling out of the track.
     - Added Spectators.
     - In Broadcast Mode, everyone who types a message in the chat will spawn as a spectator.
     - Banners have been hanged to thank Kickstarter backers.
     - Walls have been spray painted to thank Kickstarter backers.
     - Exploding barrels now despawn as intended.

- v0.322 :
     - Exclusive Hatch Available via DLC for Kickstarter backers.

- v0.323 :
     - AI pilot's car has inverted colors from the player's car in training mode.
     - Added Crowd Sounds.
     - Updated Credits.
     - Updated Logo (Update 2)

- v0.324 :
     - Tweaked Crowd Sounds.
     - Fixed Crowd Sounds playing in main menu when coming from pause menu.
     - Fixed minor Crowd Sounds related issues.
     - Added Crowd Colors.

- v0.325 :
     - Fixed a bug in video settings menu.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello combat pilots![/h1]

It's been almost a year since [b]Road Rage Royale[/b] entered Early Access.
It's been a tough year for me but I'm still here, hard at work and back with a [b]major update[/b] and plans for the near future.

[b]Update 1[/b] is live and here is the [b]Living Roadmap[/b] to the future :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34564953/2f6175b8e2e21109fd00990c32f22f8c0468f133.png[/img]

I wish you all the best,
Barmy Failure (aka The Neural Oscillations Games Team)

[h1]--- PATCH NOTES ---[/h1]
v0.301 -> v0.320 :

- v0.302 :
     - Fixed Count Down display bug when leaving a game during Start Count Down.
     - Updated Shaders (should improve performances)
     - Changed colors of the knocked out cars (for better visibility)
     - Changed rage overdrive visuals (should be a little more visible when you're not leading).
     - Particules and collisions optimisations.

- v0.303 :
     - Changed Single Player (survival mode) :
          - Last lap, best lap and average lap time display have been removed.
     - Music tweaks and debugging.
     - Tweaked Countdown animation timing.

- v0.304 :
     - Procedural music tweak for 3-4 players (music now follows the 2nd player instead of the player with the less health left)
     - Healing viewer is now displayed along with health given in BroadcasterMode.
     - Fixed Music not playing again after the game being paused.
     - Added music to pause menu.
     - Added music to end game screen.
     - In BroadcasterMode, the boss will use twitch colors.

- v0.305 :
     - Fixed music bugs in menus.
     - Car names can now be changed !

- v0.306 :

    - Various Name Customization bug fixes
    - Fixed first interactions not working between rounds in BroadcasterMode.
    - Fixed Main Theme Music synchronisation bug.

- v0.307 :

     - Fixed a serious name selection bug for player 1
     - Added handicap system (from 10% to 300% of all damages).

- v0.308 :
     - Hotfix : single player mode was broken by update v0.307 .

- v0.309 :
     - Fixed name customization when using a controller.

- v0.310 :
     - Updated smoke effect when skidding.
     - Added Skiddmarks.
     - Skiddmarks are persistent between rounds.
     - Barrels are persistent between games
     - Changed Single Player (training mode) :
          - The Player now fights against an AI Pilot.
          - AI Pilot can now be Knocked Out.
          - AI Pilot now takes damage like a real player (except from barrels)
          - AI Pilot is now as fast as a real player.
          - AI Pilot only tries to be fast (It doesn't look for a fight).
          - Single Player games now have rounds like in multiplayer games.

- v0.311:
     - Fixed a healing not being applied to the player in solo BroadcasterMode.
     - Players now receive increased damage when scratching the wall for too long (more than 2 seconds)
     - Tweaked Impact Sound Effects.
     - Fixed and Tweaked a bug to slow down AI Pilot in BroadcasterMode.
     - Ready Button is now prettier.

- v0.312 :
     - Fixed Name Input field Bugs.
     - Added Sounds to menus.
     - Added Skidd Sounds.

- v0.313 :
     - Added Boost sound.
     - Tweaked heavy impact sound.
     - Tweaked AI Pilot.

- v0.314 :
     - Updated to Unity 2019.3.15f1.
     - Changed Single Player (training mode) :
          - Tweaked AI Pilot (Piloting skills).
          - AI Pilot can now dodge barrels.
          - AI Pilot now takes damage from barrels and walls.
          - AI Pilot can no longer be stunned.
     - Ready toggle deselects itself on leave.
     - Y button can now be used to boost.
     - FPS counter can be displayed/hidden by pressing ctrl+F.
     - When a player is ready a panel shows how to play.

- v0.315 :
     - Framerate capped at 60Hz.
     - Single Player (training mode) :
          - AI Pilot doesn't lose focus anymore when another pilot explodes a barrel that AI Pilot was trying to avoid.
          - AI Pilot tweaking and debugging.
     - Barrels don't spawn close to the start line anymore.
     - Barrels get cleared from the start Area each round.
     - Barrels can now spawn in curves.
     - Car UI (life and rage bar) has been polished a little.
     - Car UI now becomes semi transparent when overlapping a car.

- v0.316 :
     - Fixed a bug where AI Pilot was slowing down after a few rounds.
     - Fixed a bug when editing player name would not lock keyboard actions on other players if player name was selected using the mouse.
     - Tweaked CarUI Transparency on Round Starts.
     - Car Collider Optimisations.

- v0.317 :
     - Car Model has been split in 4 parts.
     - Car Model and textures have been optimized.
     - Info panel has been resized. (car selection menu)

- v0.318 :
     - Credits have been updated.

- v0.319 :
     - Fix a bug that prevented AI Pilot from receiving damage when hitting a Wreck.
     - Fix a barrel spawn bug in Broadcaster Mode.

- v0.320 :
     - Logo updated. (update 1 added)
